newsitem.title: CHINA: Soccer-Few goals scored in China's league matches.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Few goals scored in China's league matches.

text.p: Matches in Sunday's 16th round of China's professional soccer league saw a goal drought with just four goals scored in five matches, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
Guangzhou Songri played to a 1-1 draw against league leaders Dalian Wanda in the only match of the day with more than one goal scored.
The other two matches that produced goals were Beijing Guo'an's loss to Jinan Taishan 1-0 at home and Yanbian Hyundai's win over Sichuan Quanxin 1-0 on home turf.
Beijing Guo'an has yet to beat Jinan Taishan in any of their matches over the past three years.
The match between defending champions Shanghai Shenhua and Guangzhou Apollo was postponed until Tuesday because the Shanghai team had just played an Asian club match on Friday.

In the two other matches played on Sunday, the Chinese Army team failed to take advantage of their high-altitude home turf in southwestern Kunming and were held to a goalless draw against Tianjin Samsung.
Guangdong Hongyuan, playing at home in Dongguan, dominated the match against Shenzhen but failed to convert any of the scoring chances.
